title: Ondagona Baa
desc: Raghu comes to his paternal village to attend his grandfather's diamond jubilee function. He finds out that due to his uncle, his family was separated, and tries to fix things.

title: Kshetrapati
desc: After his father's suicide, Basava embarks on a revolutionary journey in search of justice.

title: Odahuttidavaru
desc: Two brothers live in harmony. However, their relationship soon begins to fall apart when the younger brother's wife starts creating clashes between them.

title: Raja Mahal
desc: Three college friends decide to open a resort. However, their lives change when they start experiencing paranormal activities in their resort.

title: Auto Shankar
desc: Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a moneylender. However, tables turn when she loses her property, and they fall in love.
